    Description
    Command
    Performs some task using one or more mechanisms.
    ConflictDetector
    Utility class for helping with detecting conflicts between commands.
    ConflictDetector.Conflict
    A conflict between two commands.
    Coroutine
    A coroutine object is injected into command's Command.run(Coroutine) method to allow commands to yield and compositions to run other commands.
    Coroutine.WaitResult
    Represents the result of a call to Coroutine.waitUntil(BooleanSupplier) or Coroutine.waitUntil(BooleanSupplier, Time).
    Mechanism
    Generic interface to represent mechanisms on a robot.
    NeedsExecutionBuilderStage
    A stage in a command builder where requirements have already been specified and execution details are required.
    NeedsNameBuilderStage
    A stage in a command builder where requirements and main command execution logic have been set.
    ParallelGroup
    A type of command that runs multiple other commands in parallel.
    ParallelGroupBuilder
    A builder class to configure and then create a ParallelGroup.
    Scheduler
    Manages the lifecycles of Coroutine-based Commands.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult
    Represents possible results of a command scheduling attempt.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.AlreadyRunning
    A scheduling attempt that was redundant because the command was already running.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.Failure
    Common interface for failed scheduling attempts.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.LowerPriorityThanQueuedCommand
    A scheduling attempt that failed because the command was lower priority than a queued command with shared requirements.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.LowerPriorityThanRunningCommand
    A scheduling attempt that failed because the command was lower priority than a running command with shared requirements.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.Success
    A successful scheduling attempt.
    Scheduler.ScheduleResult.Successful
    Common interface for successful scheduling attempts.
    SchedulerEvent
    An event that occurs during scheduler processing.
    SchedulerEvent.Canceled
    An event marking when a command was canceled.
    SchedulerEvent.Completed
    An event marking when a command completed naturally.
    SchedulerEvent.CompletedWithError
    An event marking when a command threw or encountered an unhanded exception.
    SchedulerEvent.Interrupted
    An event marking when a command was interrupted by another.
    SchedulerEvent.Mounted
    An event marking when a command starts running.
    SchedulerEvent.Scheduled
    An event marking when a command is scheduled in Scheduler.schedule(Command).
    SchedulerEvent.Yielded
    An event marking when a command yielded control with Coroutine.yield().
    SequentialGroup
    A sequence of commands that run one after another.
    SequentialGroupBuilder
    A builder class to configure and then create a SequentialGroup.
    StagedCommandBuilder
    A builder class for commands.
    StateMachine
    A declarative state machine that can be used to implement complex command routines.
    StateMachine.State
    A state in a state machine.
    StateMachine.TransitionNeedsConditionStage
    A builder to set conditions for a transition from one state to another.
    StateMachine.TransitionNeedsTargetStage
    A builder for a transition from one state to another.
    Trigger
    Triggers allow users to specify conditions for when commands should run.
